summary: Steady Energy Oy designs, constructs, and operates compact nuclear heating plants that provide carbon-free heat using small modular nuclear reactors. Its LDR-50 is a heat-only, water-cooled reactor designed for low temperature and low pressure, and is primarily targeted at district heat production, as well as district cooling, industrial heating processes, and desalination. The company offers its heat generating plants and related services through commercial models, such as engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) and heat-as-a-service (HAAS) models. Its primary target market consists of district heating companies in European cities. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Espoo, Finland.
